summary: Completed Module 2 CI/CD pipeline work with verified fail-fast behavior, BREAK/FIX diagnosis, and policy hardening for security, performance, and branch-safe publish controls.
evidence: Implemented `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with parallel lint/test validation and verified local CI-equivalent pass-path checks.
Validated fail-fast behavior with intentional test break (`AssertionError`) and confirmed downstream sentinel stage did not execute.
Isolated supported regression to duplicated dependency installs without cache reuse; current local snapshot did not support active secret leak or branch deploy leak.

Defined FIX controls: CI secret-manager-only handling with no log exposure, pip cache reuse strategy via actions cache keyed by OS and requirements hash, and protected-branch-only policy for future Docker publish/deploy steps.
